A designer's role is to create an engaging game for players, retain those players over time, and devise a sustainable monetization model to fund further development. Whether you are a novice designer or a veteran, Roblox offers a variety of resources to help you through the design process.

## What's new

## Design your game

- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/design-for-roblox|Design for Roblox:]] Learn how Roblox is unique as a platform and how to design games with these factors in mind.
- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/core-loops|Core loops:]] Learn how to design central gameplay systems to build your game from the ground up.
- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/prototyping|Prototyping:]] Learn different prototyping methods for exploring your game's potential and how they can help bring your vision to life.

## Build your game

- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/onboarding|Onboarding:]] Learn how to design an effective onboarding experience to retain as many new players as possible, increase potential concurrent and daily active users, and improve your game's monetization potential.
- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/onboarding-techniques|Onboarding techniques:]] Learn strategies to help direct players through the onboarding funnel as quickly and seamlessly as possible.
- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/introduction-to-quest-design|Quest design:]] Learn how to effectively design quests, achievements, and dailies to increase engagement and retention in your games.
- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/ui-ux-design|UI and UX design:]] Learn how to design user interfaces and how to design an intuitive and engaging game.

## Monetize your experience

- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/monetization-foundations|Monetization foundations:]] Learn monetization best practices and shop design to maximize your experience's monetary growth potential.
- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/season-pass-design|Season pass design:]] Learn how to design season passes for your experiences to deliver new content, promote player retention, and generate revenue.
- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/subscription-design|Subscription design:]] Learn how to design recurring purchases that your players look forward to each month.
- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/contextual-purchases|Contextual purchases:]] Learn how to design compelling and unintrusive purchase opportunities that occur outside an experience's shop.
- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/balance-virtual-economies|Balance virtual economies:]] Learn best practices to balance virtual economies when introducing new events.

## Support your game

- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/liveops-essentials|LiveOps essentials:]] Learn how to design content that keeps players coming back and enjoying your game after launch.
- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/liveops-essentials|LiveOps planning:]] Learn how to maintain a dynamic and captivating game through interweaving the release of two types of content.
- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/analytics-essentials|Analytics essentials:]] Learn how to leverage key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify the health of your game and potential growth opportunities.
- [[external/roblox-creator-docs/production/game-design/content-updates|Content updates:]] Learn how to design content cadences to keep players engaged between larger game updates.
